body.statement: Let \(t_\gamma(x)=B(x)^\top\vartheta\) be the degree-\(\lceil\gamma\rceil-1\) Taylor polynomial of \(\tau\) at \(x_0\), and let \(r=\tau-t_\gamma\). Then \(W_{lr}=\langle B_lB_r,\pi(1-\pi)\rangle_h+\langle Q_{h,\ell}(B_l\pi),Q_{h,\ell}(B_r\pi)\rangle_h\), and \((V-W\vartheta)_l=\langle Q_{h,\ell}(B_l\pi),Q_{h,\ell}\mu_0\rangle_h+\langle B_l\pi,r\rangle_h-\langle P_{h,\ell}(B_l\pi),P_{h,\ell}(\pi r)\rangle_h\). Consequently \(\lambda_{\min}(W)\ge c>0\) and \(|e_1^\top W^{-1}V-\tau(x_0)|\le C(h^\gamma+\ell^q)\).
body.justification: The identity converts two rough nuisance approximations into their product while preserving the smoother CATE localization bias.
body.gap: Kennedy et al. derive a localized higher-order product bias with nuisance pilots; the exact fixed-uniform projection identity without pilots is not in their construction.
body.consumer: It supplies the bias calculation for a single protected higher-order release rather than separately privatized nuisance fits.
